reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000030 (the melody read from 000030a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Michael Haydn's dates (1737–1806) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Haydn_Michael (Haydn, Michael, 1737-1806); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Haydn (14 September 1737 - 10 August 1806). GREENLAND, LYONS and SALZBURG had borrowed Joseph Haydn's 1732-1809 through the surname-and-initial fallback.; CCEH's page gives none. William Gardiner's dates (1770–1853) are from our page for the tune BELMONT (content/hymns/tunes/belmont.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1815. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000030a.nwc).
